collapse.why: The three-category scope the client accepted from the #117 feasibility report: spawanie, ukladanie_pretow, and everything else as one collective line. Every figure in that report was produced on seven categories, so the vocabulary actually being delivered had never been scored (#121).
collapse.excludes: nierozpoznane is deliberately NOT a member and keeps its own row. The manifest defines it as never work and never downtime, and the client report says the same; folding the honest cannot-tell into a collective work bucket would convert 3.4% of unknown time into measured time.
collapse.integrity: The categories were fixed by the client acceptance of the #117 scope, which predates this scoring - the mapping is not chosen from arm results. But seven-category arm results WERE already known when this block was written, so like the 3-fold split it is not a blind pre-registration, and it is recorded that way rather than implied to be one.
collapse.never_mix: A three-category figure is not comparable with a seven-category one and the two must never appear in the same table. evaluate_arms.py enforces the separation in the renderer; a reader cannot undo a merge by reading harder.
